definitions.gloss: one size fits all; free size
definitions.explanation: A clothing size designation meaning a garment is made to fit a wide range of body sizes rather than being offered in S, M, L, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フリーサイズだ。
examples.english: This shirt is one size fits all.

examples.japanese: フリーサイズだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{試着|しちゃく}→試着：07690_shichaku⟧⟦しなくて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧だろう。
examples.english: It's one size fits all, so I probably don't need to try it on.

examples.japanese: フリーサイズ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあって→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even if it says one size fits all, it may not fit some people.

notes:
A Japanese-made English term ("free" + "size"). It does not mean the size is literally adjustable, only that a single cut is intended to suit many builds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フリーサイズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: one-size-fits-all clothing
- ⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フリーサイズ⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧: available in one size only

USAGE:
Most common for loose items such as accessories, hats, and oversized tops. The English-style label ワンサイズ is also seen.
